record.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.05081. Abstract summary: Recent advances in autoregressive video diffusion have enabled real-time frame streaming, yet existing solutions still suffer from temporal repetition, drift, and motion deceleration. We find that naively applying StreamingLLM-style attention sinks to video diffusion leads to fidelity degradation and motion stagnation. To overco Out of scope: Deep sink/compression for long video generation with DiTs, outside LLM scope.
record.title: Deep Forcing: Training-Free Long Video Generation with Deep Sink and Participative Compression
